snippet.title: DCS: F4U-1D CORSAIR
snippet.description:
The ‘Bent Wing Bird’, as she was affectionately named, was built for long range air-to-air and air-to-ground attack operations and packed a serious punch with rockets, bombs and machine guns. It mainly flew over the expanse of the Pacific theater from land bases, but also operated from Essex-class aircraft carriers. 

E-shop: https://www.digitalcombatsimulator.com/en/shop/modules/corsair/
